clippings.speaker: Federico Fellini
clippings.quote: Nino is an angelic friend made of music, always with an angel of music by his side, with its huge wings about him.
clippings.title: A portrait of composer Nino Rota
clippings.context: Fellini's tribute quoted by Jon Burlingame in a CSO profile of Rota; original source and date not given.

clippings.speaker: Federico Fellini
clippings.quote: stress vanished and everything became a party. The film entered a light, serene, fantastical phase, an atmosphere from which it gained a kind of new life.
clippings.title: A portrait of composer Nino Rota
clippings.context: Fellini on what happened when Rota arrived near the end of each project, quoted in a CSO profile; original source not given.

clippings.speaker: Federico Fellini
clippings.quote: You felt his creativity so near at hand that it gave you a feeling of inebriation, the sensation that it was you producing the music. It entered so completely into the characters, the atmosphere, the colours of my films as to permeate them with his music.
clippings.title: Nino Rota
clippings.context: Fellini's verdict on Rota's contribution to his films, quoted by Mervyn Cooke; original source not given.

clippings.speaker: Federico Fellini
clippings.quote: With Nino I can spend whole days listening to him play the piano in order to pin down a motif, to clarify some musical phrase that matches as exactly as possible the emotion I want to express in a sequence
clippings.original: Con Nino puedo pasarme días enteros, oyéndolo tocar el piano con el fin de precisar un motivo, de aclarar alguna frase musical que coincida lo más exactamente posible con la emoción que deseo expresar en una secuencia
clippings.title: Nino Rota, el otro yo musical de Fellini
clippings.context: Something Fellini wrote about working with Rota, quoted in Spanish translation in a Rota centenary piece by Fernando López.

clippings.speaker: Nino Rota
clippings.quote: If I hadn’t managed to replace the music Federico held so dear, tied to the world of the circus and to Chaplin, our partnership would probably have ended before it began. Instead, our friendship and collaboration have never been interrupted. It’s not that Federico is insensitive to music, it’s that he is too affected by it.
clippings.original: Se non fossi riuscito a sostituire le musiche tanto care a Federico, legate al mondo del circo e a Chaplin, probabilmente il nostro sodalizio sarebbe finito sul nascere. Al contrario la nostra amicizia e collaborazione non si sono mai interrotte. Non è che Federico sia insensibile alla musica, è che ne rimane troppo colpito.
clippings.title: Sulle musiche legate al circo si giocò il sodalizio fra Fellini e Rota
clippings.context: Rota in a public conversation with Fellini on his Radio2 program "Voi ed io", recalling The White Sheik; reported from a La Repubblica audio excerpt.

clippings.speaker: Nino Rota
clippings.quote: We had spent the whole day fiddling about at the piano, but nothing was coming. Finally, just as I was about to leave, I play a tune, Federico stops and says to me, this one’s good, we’ll do the whole film with it
clippings.original: Eravamo stati tutta la giornata a cincischiare al pianoforte, ma non usciva niente. Finalmente, al momento di andar via, suono un motivo, Federico si ferma e mi dice, questo va bene, ci facciamo tutto il film
clippings.title: HOT CORN RADIO | Fellini, Nino Rota e le colonne sonore più belle in una playlist
clippings.context: Rota describing in an unnamed interview how the Amarcord theme was found;

clippings.speaker: Nino Rota
clippings.quote: He might tell me, make a cheerful tune but one that’s sad. An oldish tune but one that’s new, carefree but poignant…
clippings.original: Magari mi dice, fai un motivo allegro ma che sia triste. Un motivo vecchiotto ma che sia nuovo, spensierato ma patetico…
clippings.title: HOT CORN RADIO | Fellini, Nino Rota e le colonne sonore più belle in una playlist
clippings.context: Rota, continuing the same unnamed interview, on Fellini's contradictory musical briefs;

notes: Film Score Monthly piece 403'd. Rota's own words on Fellini exist only in Italian secondary sources (quoted verbatim, untranslated); the Fellini quotes all come from secondary pieces that name no original source.
